title: Add Oxlint alongside ESLint
description: Register `@nx/oxlint` and add Oxlint targets alongside the existing ESLint setup. ESLint configuration is left untouched.

project.description: Limit the conversion to a single project.

targetName.description: Name for the added Oxlint target.

addExplicitTargets.description: Add explicit `@nx/oxlint:lint` targets for projects that have an explicit `@nx/eslint:lint` target. Projects with an inferred ESLint target get an inferred Oxlint target instead.

keepExistingVersions.description: Keep existing dependency versions when possible.
